objective.value: Keep one shared list of the books our household is reading and which ones are finished.

users.value: The people living in this household, sharing one list.

problem.value: We buy a book twice and nobody remembers who already finished it.

smallestVersion.value: A list you can add a book to and mark as finished.

approved.value: Decide technology in a first architecture/discovery cell

sensitiveData.value: No money and no health data; only book titles and a household nickname per reader.

involvement.value: Approve each step before it is built.

decisions.question: Which technology should the first version use?
decisions.proposal: Decide technology in a first architecture/discovery cell

acceptance.value: adding a book shows it in the list
marking it finished moves it out of the unread list
